name: What preparation is needed before interior painting?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before interior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before interior painting, surfaces need to be clean, dry, and smooth. This often involves cleaning walls, filling holes and cracks, sanding uneven areas, and sometimes priming. Protecting floors and furniture with drop cloths and plastic sheeting is also crucial. Frasheski Construction handles all necessary preparation to ensure a high-quality, lasting finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation for interior painting includes cleaning, patching, sanding, and priming surfaces, plus protecting floors and furniture.
